instruction: Repair decoder.decode_chunks(chunks). Each input string contains a valid even-length hexadecimal encoding of a byte chunk; chunks may be empty. Concatenate the bytes logically and decode UTF-8 strictly even when a code point spans chunk boundaries. Return the decoded string, preserving BOM as U+FEFF. Reject invalid, overlong, or incomplete-final UTF-8 with ValueError. Do not replace invalid bytes or mutate the chunk list. Hex syntax is valid and need not be validated.
